slides.title: Marshmallow time
slides.text: Grab a stick at the marshmallow station and hold it over the fire - not too long!

slides.title: Play the logs
slides.text: Pick up a mallet and hit the painted logs - everyone hears your song.

slides.title: Take the zipline
slides.text: Climb up to the platform and grab the zipline handle for a ride over the island.

slides.title: Look at the moon
slides.text: Aim the telescope at the moon and keep it in the crosshair...
